mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in FEDFUNDS signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns fail to outperform baseline during FEDFUNDS rises (p > 0.05 t-test)

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflation acceleration (CPIAUCSL > 2.0%) triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher interest rates and reduced growth prospects.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain non-negative during CPIAUCSL > 2.0% periods (p > 0.05)

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in FEDFUNDS (monetary) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) create an expansionary policy environment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through reduced policy uncertainty and growth expectations.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over 20d horizon during interaction periods

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals labor market strength, attracting capital to equities and generating positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20d returns fail to rise when UNRATE < 4.0% (p > 0.05)

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in business activity (INDPRO < 95.0%) reduces growth prospects, prompting risk-off behavior and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain non-negative during INDPRO < 95.0% periods (p > 0.05)

mechanism_narrative: Strong demand growth (GDPC1) and robust manufacturing activity (HOUST) both rising simultaneously amplify equity valuations, driving positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20d returns fail to rise during both proxies' increases (p > 0.05)

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS rises during late-cycle expansion erode growth expectations, compressing equity valuations and generating negative 60-day returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases during late-cycle expansion regime
failure_condition: 20d returns remain non-negative when FEDFUNDS rises in late-cycle (p > 0.05)

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in consumer demand (GDPC1) and industrial production (RSAFS) signals robust growth, driving positive 20-day returns through expanded profit margins.
failure_condition: 20d returns fail to rise during both proxies' increases (p > 0.05)
